# Model brand assets

These marks identify the model or service selected by the user. They remain the
property of their respective owners and do not imply endorsement of poie. They
are not poie's product identity. Preserve the original colors and proportions.

Retrieved on 2026-10-25. Assets are bundled in `public/model-logos/` for both web
and desktop use; displaying an avatar does not contact an external image host.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `gemini.png` | Google LLC | [Gemini icon archive](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Google_Gemini_icon_2025.svg), which attributes its inline SVG source to Google's About Gemini page; [SVG file](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1d/Google_Gemini_icon_2025.svg) | SVG rasterized at 256 × 256; no redrawing or recoloring |
| `deepseek.png` | DeepSeek | [DeepSeek website](https://www.deepseek.com/), [original icon](https://www.deepseek.com/favicon.ico) | ICO decoded to PNG |
